brief.brief: Instrumental game exploration theme for Wildshard, a world that arrives one chunk at a time: wonder first, adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. No vocals. 60-90 s, loopable (it will be trimmed to a bar-exact loop). The model composes freely - no required motif.
brief.title: Sparse piano + ambient
brief.reference: Breath of the Wild field music
brief.ace_caption: Sparse solo piano with ambient pads, open-world exploration video game soundtrack in the style of Breath of the Wild. Gentle, spacious grand piano phrases with long rests between notes, soft felt tone and sustain pedal; a distant airy pad and faint string harmonics underneath; an occasional glassy bell. Wide natural reverb. Mood: wonder first, quiet adventure second, a little melancholy underneath - a world slowly appearing one piece at a time. Instrumental, no vocals, no drums. D major with a Lydian raised fourth.
brief.sao_prompt: Sparse solo grand piano with soft ambient pad, open-world video game exploration music, gentle, wistful, spacious reverb, no drums, D major, 80 BPM
brief.sao_negative: drums, vocals, distortion, low quality, noise
brief.minimax_prompt: Genre: video game soundtrack, ambient solo piano. BPM: 80. Key: D major with a Lydian raised fourth. Instrumental only, no vocals. Mood: wonder first, quiet adventure second, a little melancholy underneath - an open world appearing one piece at a time, like Breath of the Wild's field music. Arrangement: sparse grand piano phrases with long rests and soft sustain pedal; a distant airy pad and faint string harmonics underneath; an occasional glassy bell; no drums. Production: intimate close-miked piano, wide natural reverb.
